title: PROD | NCCM | Connectivity Validation Should Be Performed Through Assigned Collector
description:
Currently, some customers have their *Head Office (HO)* and *Branch* environments located at different geographical locations. In such deployments, the customer provides a dedicated {*}Collector for each branch{*}, while the {*}HO contains the Main/Master server{*}.

The branch devices are reachable from their respective Collector but are {*}not directly reachable from the Main/Master server{*}.

In the current scenario:
 # The device is discovered using a {*}Discovery Profile{*}.
 # The device is added to Inventory and Monitor settings with a {*}specific Collector assigned{*}.
 # Monitoring and polling work successfully through the assigned Collector.
 # However, when the same device is onboarded for {*}NCCM from the Inventory screen{*}, the connectivity validation is performed from the {*}Main/Master server{*}.
 # Since the branch device is not directly reachable from the Master server, the NCCM onboarding fails with {*}Ping/Port connectivity errors{*}, even though the device is accessible through its assigned Collector.

h3. Expected Behavior / Acceptance Criteria

If a device is already discovered through a Collector or has a {*}specific Collector assigned{*}, then during {*}NCCM onboarding and connectivity validation{*}, the application should perform the connectivity checks from the *same assigned Collector* instead of the Main/Master server.
